purpose.statement: A Dialog composition that uses a trigger, content, a header with title and description, and a footer for actions.

whatItIs.statement: A dialog flow with a dialog surface, a trigger/action control, and footer action roles.

whenToUse.statement: Use this pattern when an interaction is presented in a Dialog and needs follow-up controls in the documented footer action area.

howToUse.statement: Use the documented Dialog composition: an opening trigger, dialog content, a header with title and description, and a footer for actions.
Use Button for the opening control or for custom action and close controls in the Dialog examples.

guidance.statement: The Dialog provides the overlaid surface for this pattern.
The Dialog examples use a Button as the opening control and as a custom action or close control.
The footer role is an action area; Button is the documented control used in the Dialog examples.
